Strategy: Reward leftovers between thirty and forty-five, but penalize near-exact leftovers between zero and five, steering away from almost-closed bins toward mid-size leftovers. It may help by keeping bins usefully open, but may fail by shunning the exact fits that save bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 0 and r - item <= 5 else 0) for r in bins]
```
